notes.title: Let's play Dolmenjord - Vilking Islands!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41937677/42c6d9a83597a15644ec5ec1dc89ad3c7411956e.png[/img]

Dolmenjord is a game inspired by Norse mythology, where Vikings need help to organize their buildings and villages and thus solve the puzzles and dominate new lands.

It is available now!

Great for Nordic culture fans who love to be challenged with logic puzzles.

Set up each village according to the rules:
- Place all the available houses and walkway pieces.
- Every house must face the walkway.
-  The completed walkway must give access to the port.

The puzzles are simple in the early islands, but it gets challenging as you advance in the exploration. If you prefer a more relaxing journey, that's fine!
Whenever you want, you can enable the Casual Mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41937677/0577d939cf97d6c0faadc7f7a473c1082d2151f5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41937677/0ce7c6cd9022add3519c6fd9c6425d9d2acb7393.jpg[/img]

notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35765065/54142ae676dabc8990a2085a61f7a66edc7b67e7.jpg[/img]

Hi, folks!

[u][b]Island Cities[/b][/u] is the game we are releasing next. 🏣🏬

Cities are usually concrete jungles, noisy and stressful.
But you can also entertain yourself by looking at how they are organized, finding interesting details, and seeing life unfold. Then you can see that they are also vibrant and full of life.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35765065/21c591bec4d698eb6a7a3a9f0344e1f32a2fa104.gif[/img]

Carefully observe the island, try to memorize it, then shuffle the blocks. Swap blocks to reproduce the desired island and the city will emerge.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35765065/2878dba47a92b99123028c9889b15f681eca17b0.gif[/img]

notes.title: Update - DLC Little Inner Monsters Artbook and Cards in Portuguese (Brazil)
notes.content:
Hi, we've just included a Brazilian Portuguese version of the Artbook and Printable Cards!
The PDF file is in the same folder as the English version and the soundtrack.
Those who purchased the DLC will receive the update automatically.
Thanks for supporting us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42269334/ee9c5975c97baaf634bb59bf7649c46405d3413c.png[/img]

This DLC is extra content to Unlock the Feelings and Little Inner Monsters, where you get:
- Artbook including the inspiration for creating the monsters, initial drafts of the art from artist Katia Numakura. In PDF format.
- Printable versions of the Cards for you to play a physical simplified version of the card game. In PDF format.
- The soundtrack with six arrangements, fit for different moods. In MP3 format.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1973430/Little_Inner_Monsters__Artbook__Printable_Cards__Soundtrack/

notes.title: Update - Introducing colorblind options
notes.content:
Hi, thanks for playing the game and for your support!

To improve the game accessibility, we implemented colorblind options. I was a feature requested by the community.

We are using the Colorblind component, which applies a filter for different types of colorblindness, provided by SOHNE. 
It can be found here: [url=https://github.com/SOHNE/Colorblindness]github[/url] - Copyright 2020 SOHNE
Thanks for that amazing solution!

There are also some small bug fixes.

We hope you enjoy it.
If you are colorblind, let us know in the Community forum if the implementation was helpful. Your feedback is welcome.

Keep playing and writing in the diary! 
Best regards.
